headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 13-1 behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox have placed right-hander Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants have transferred third baseman Matt Chapman to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

The Boston Red Sox have placed right-hander Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have placed center fielder James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed catcher Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to left hip inflammation.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise to 13-1 Victory Over Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 13-1 behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Clinch Thrilling 1-0 Victory Over Yankees**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a narrow 1-0 win over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert pitching 6.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Weston Wilson led the Mariners' offense with a solo home run in the game.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki had a notable performance for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Mariners' Colt Emerson Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The trade also includes a player to be named later.
